Subject: SI-PM-0003 supplier qualification — request for supporting evidence (SUP-03)

Hello Hammer Industries team,

Thank you for your packet for SI-PM-0003. Your packet states the following items without supporting records. Please send evidence for each:

1. 1.internal_audit — internal audit program: procedure and most recent audit report.
2. 1.capa — documented corrective-action (CAPA) process and a sample record.
3. 1.calibration — gauge calibration program covering production gauges, with calibration records.
4. 2.pfmea — current process FMEA for this part.
5. 2.control_plan — control plan showing coverage of Output voltage, Connector pitch and Mounting-hole pitch.
6. 2.spc — SPC in use on the CTQs now: control charts and reaction plan.
7. 3.inspection_method — the specific inspection method and equipment used for each CTQ tolerance.
8. 5.lot_trace — lot or serial traceability to raw material, with an example trace record.
9. 5.nc_segregation — procedure and records for identifying and segregating nonconforming material.
10. 8.flowdown — evidence that requirements are flowed down to your sub-tier supplier.

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: Review the raw data and calculation behind the capability study (capability_study.md §9.1): lowest Cpk is 0.6273 on Mounting-hole pitch, with 0.6385 and 0.6330 on the other CTQs. Confirm sampling, and ask what process actions are under way.

Walk through the Output voltage gauge study (msa.md §9.1): %GRR of tolerance is 35.10 against 16.59 and 22.03 on the other gauges. Observe the measurement setup, check appraiser technique and gauge calibration status.
Trace a finished lot back to raw material on the floor. The packet only claims traceability (quality_manual.md §1.3). Ask to see the trace records, lot labels and the material-receipt link.
